paragraphs: We are a geographically diversified gaming and hospitality company that was founded in 1973 by the Carano family with the opening of the Eldorado Hotel Casino in Reno, Nevada. Beginning in 2005, we grew through a series of acquisitions, including the acquisition of MTR Gaming Group, Inc. in 2014, Isle of Capri Casinos, Inc. in 2017, Tropicana Entertainment, Inc. in 2018, Caesars Entertainment Corporation in 2020, and William Hill PLC in 2021. Our ticker symbol on the NASDAQ Stock Market is "CZR."

Our primary source of revenue is generated by our gaming operations, which includes our casino properties, retail and online sports betting and online gaming. Additionally, we utilize our hotels, restaurants, bars, entertainment, racing, retail shops and other services to attract customers to our properties.

As of December 31, 2025, we own, lease or manage an aggregate of 52 domestic properties in 18 states. We also operate and conduct sports wagering across 34 jurisdictions in North America, 27 of which offer online sports betting, and operate iGaming in five jurisdictions in North America. We currently operate the Caesars Sportsbook app, the Caesars Racebook app, the Caesars Palace Online Casino app and the Horseshoe Online Casino app. We expect to continue to grow our operations in the Caesars Digital segment as new jurisdictions legalize retail and online sports betting and iGaming. In addition, we have other properties in North America that are authorized to use the brands and marks of Caesars Entertainment, Inc., as well as other non-gaming properties. We lease certain real property assets from third parties, including GLP Capital, L.P., the operating partnership of Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc. ("GLPI") and VICI Properties L.P., a Delaware limited partnership ("VICI"). See Item 2. "Properties," for more information about our properties.

Our consolidated business is composed of complementary businesses that reinforce, cross-promote, and build upon each other: casino, which includes our casino properties, retail and online sports betting and iGaming, food and beverage, hotel, casino management or branding, entertainment, retail and other business operations.

Our casino operations generate revenues from approximately 51,400 slot machines, 2,700 table games, including poker, sports betting from our retail and online sportsbooks, iGaming and other games such as keno, all of which represented approximately 58% of our total net revenues in 2025. Slot revenues generate the majority of our casino revenues.
Retail and Online Sports Betting and iGaming

The Company operates and conducts sports wagering across 34 jurisdictions in North America, 27 of which offer online sports betting, and operates iGaming in five jurisdictions in North America as of December 31, 2025. We offer hundreds of online casino games including slots, table games, live dealer and video poker and we expect to increase our product offerings as iGaming is legalized in additional states. We continue to leverage the World Series of Poker ("WSOP") brand within the United States with the licensing agreement that we entered into concurrently with the sale of the WSOP brand on October 29, 2024.

Our Caesars Sportsbook app operates on our owned and integrated technology platform we have labeled Liberty ("Liberty"). The app offers extensive pre-match and live markets, extensive odds and flexible limits, player props, and same-game parlays. In addition to the Caesars Sportsbook app, we have a partnership with NYRABets LLC, the official online wagering platform of the New York Racing Association, Inc., and operate the Caesars Racebook app in 22 states. The Caesars Racebook app provides access for pari-mutuel wagering at over 300 racetracks around the world as well as livestreaming of races. Additionally, we launched our Caesars Palace Online Casino app in 2023 and our Horseshoe Online Casino app in 2024. In 2025, we added the Caesars Racebook wagering interface to the Caesars Sportsbook app and launched a universal digital wallet to access funds and Caesars Rewards in one wallet. These functions are currently available in several states with plans to extend to more jurisdictions in the future. Wagers placed can earn credits towards the Caesars Rewards loyalty program or points which can be redeemed for free wagering credits. No customers under 21 years old are allowed to wager on any of our Caesars Sportsbook, Caesars Racebook and iGaming mobile apps. Growth in the Caesars Digital segment continues to be realized with the strategic expansion into new states as jurisdictions legalize retail and online sports betting, iGaming and online horse race wagering.

Our food and beverage operations generate revenues from our dining venues, bars, nightclubs, and lounges located throughout our casinos and represented approximately 15% of our total net revenues in 2025. Many of our properties include several dining options, ranging from upscale dining experiences to moderately-priced restaurants, some of which offer pickup or in-room delivery options.

Hotel operations generate revenues from hotel stays at our properties in our approximately 45,600 guest rooms and suites and represented approximately 17% of our total net revenues in 2025. Our properties operate at various price and service points, allowing us to host a variety of casino guests, who are visiting our properties for gaming and other casino entertainment options, and non-casino guests who are visiting our properties for other purposes, such as vacation travel or conventions.

We earn revenue from fees paid for the management of other hotels and casinos in North America. Managed properties represent Caesars-branded properties where we provide certain staffing and management services under management agreements. In addition, we authorize the use of certain brands and marks of Caesars Entertainment, Inc. from which we earn revenue from fees received based on the arrangements.
Entertainment and Other Non-Gaming Operations

We provide a variety of retail and entertainment offerings at our properties. We operate various entertainment venues across the United States, including the Colosseum at Caesars Palace Las Vegas and PH Live at Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino. These award-winning entertainment venues host or have announced plans to host prominent headliners such as Rod Stewart, Jerry Seinfeld, Kelly Clarkson, Def Leppard, Dolly Parton, Jennifer Lopez and Blake Shelton.

On December 12, 2024, we sold the LINQ Promenade, which was an open-air dining, entertainment, and retail development located between The LINQ Hotel & Casino and Flamingo Las Vegas. We continue to operate the High Roller, a 550-foot observation wheel, and Fly LINQ, the first and only zipline on the Las Vegas Strip located between The LINQ Hotel & Casino and Flamingo Las Vegas.

headings: Risks Relating to Operating Our Business
We face substantial competition and expect that such competition will continue.
Our business is sensitive to reductions in discretionary consumer spending as a result of downturns in the economy and other factors outside our control.

The growth of our digital business will require investments in our online offerings, technology and strategic marketing initiatives, which could be costly and negatively impact the economics of our online business.
We face the risk of fraud, theft, and cheating.
We extend credit to a portion of our customers, and we may not be able to collect gaming receivables from our credit customers.
The outbreak of pandemics and other public health matters and related impacts have had, and may once again have, a significant impact on our operations and results of operations.
Acts of terrorism, war, natural disasters, severe weather, and political, economic and military conditions may impede our ability to operate or may negatively impact our financial results.
Climate change regulations and greenhouse gas effects may adversely impact our operations.
Our business may be subject to fluctuations due to seasonality and other factors that could result in volatility and have an adverse effect on our operating results.
Our business is particularly sensitive to energy or water prices and a rise in these prices could harm our operating results.
Any deterioration in our reputation or the reputation of our brands could adversely impact our business, financial condition, or results of operations.
Risks Relating to Information Systems and Technology

We are vulnerable to compromises of our information systems and unauthorized access to confidential information or our customers' personal information which could materially harm our reputation and business.
Our online business is dependent on the Internet and we rely on Amazon Web Services and other third-party technology, platforms and services to deliver our offerings to users.
Risks Related to Human Capital
We rely on our key personnel and we may face difficulties in attracting and retaining qualified employees for our casinos and racetracks.
Work stoppages and other labor problems could negatively impact our future profits.
We cannot assure you that we will be able to retain our performers and other entertainment offerings on acceptable terms or at all.
Risks Relating to Our Capital Structure

Despite our current indebtedness levels, we and our subsidiaries may still incur significant additional indebtedness. Incurring more indebtedness could increase the risks associated with our substantial indebtedness.
Our variable rate indebtedness exposes us to interest rate volatility, which could cause our debt service obligations to increase significantly.

A significant portion of our casinos are located on leased property. If we default on one or more leases, the applicable lessors could terminate the affected leases and we could lose possession of the affected casino.
Legal and Regulatory Risks

We are subject to extensive governmental regulation, taxation policies and licensing, and gaming authorities have significant control over our operations, which could have an adverse effect on our business.
paragraphs: The gaming industry is highly competitive and competition is intense in most of the markets in which we operate. We compete with a variety of gaming operations, including land-based casinos, dockside casinos, riverboat casinos, casinos located on racing tracks, casinos located on Native American reservations and other forms of legalized gaming such as video gaming terminals at bars, restaurants and truck stops and online gambling and sports betting. We also compete, to a lesser extent, with other forms of legalized gaming and entertainment such as bingo, pull tab games, card parlors, sportsbooks, fantasy sports websites, cruise line operations, pari-mutuel or telephonic betting on horse racing and dog racing, state-sponsored lotteries and, in the future, may compete with gaming at other venues. In addition, we compete more generally with other forms of entertainment for the discretionary spending of our customers. In some instances, particularly in the case of Native American casinos, our competitors pay lower taxes or no taxes.

In recent years, many casino and online gaming operators, including us, have reinvested in existing jurisdictions to attract new customers or to gain market share, thereby increasing competition in those jurisdictions. In particular, we and other online betting and gaming operators have undertaken extensive marketing campaigns and made significant investments in customer acquisition through pricing and promotional policies. In addition, in response to changing trends, Las Vegas operators have focused on expanding their non-gaming offerings, including upgrades to hotel rooms, new food and beverage offerings, and new entertainment offerings. The expansion of online betting and gaming in new jurisdictions and the growth of the number of competitors in the online betting and gaming market, the expansion of existing casino entertainment properties, the increase in the number of properties, and the aggressive marketing strategies of many of our competitors have increased competition in many markets in which we operate, and this intense competition is expected to continue. These competitive pressures have and are expected to continue to adversely affect our financial performance.

Our brick-and-mortar operations face increasing competition as a result of the expansion of legalized online gaming and betting, including our own online betting and gaming operations, in a number of the jurisdictions in which we operate. Additionally, we face new competition from sports event trading as derivative products in prediction markets regulated by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission. This new competition purports to be available nationwide and is currently being offered by a growing number of providers. While we believe that we are well positioned to compete with new entrants to the betting and gaming market through our online betting and gaming offerings, the competitive dynamic is evolving and we cannot assure you that our results of operations will not be adversely impacted by the expansion of legalized online gaming and betting.

States that already have legalized casino gaming may further expand gaming, and other states that have not yet legalized gaming, may do so in the future. We also compete with Native American gaming operations in California and other jurisdictions where Native American tribes operate large-scale gaming facilities or otherwise conduct gaming activities on Native American lands, which we expect will continue to expand. Further expansion of legalized casino gaming in jurisdictions in or near our markets or changes to gaming laws in states in which we have operations and in states near our operations could increase competition and could adversely affect our operations.

Increased competition may require us to make substantial expenditures in marketing, customer development and capital projects to maintain and enhance the competitive positions of our online and brick and mortar operations to increase the attractiveness and add to the appeal of our facilities and product offerings. Because a significant portion of our cash flow is required to pay obligations under our outstanding indebtedness and our lease obligations, there can be no assurance that we will have sufficient funds to undertake, or that we will be able to obtain sufficient financing to fund, such expenditures. If we are unable to make such expenditures, our competitive position could be negatively affected.

Consumer demand for leisure activities such as casinos, hotels, racetracks, online betting, iGaming and other forms of hospitality or gambling is particularly sensitive to downturns in the economy, inflation and the associated impact on discretionary spending. Changes in discretionary consumer spending or consumer preferences brought about by factors such as perceived or actual general economic conditions, effects of declines in consumer confidence in the economy, the impact of high energy and food costs, rising interest rates, the increased cost of travel, decreased disposable consumer income and wealth, fears of war and future acts of terrorism, or widespread illnesses, epidemics, or similar public health emergencies, can have a material adverse effect on leisure and business travel, discretionary spending and other areas of economic behavior that directly impact the gaming and entertainment industries in general and could further reduce customer demand for the amenities and

paragraphs: The following discussion should be read in conjunction with, and is qualified in its entirety by, the audited consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto and other financial information included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
Caesars Entertainment, Inc., a Delaware corporation, and its subsidiaries, may be referred to as the "Company," "CEI," "Caesars," "we," "our," "us," or the "Registrant."

We also refer to (i) our Consolidated Financial Statements as our "Financial Statements," (ii) our Consolidated Balance Sheets as our "Balance Sheets," (iii) our Consolidated Statements of Operations and Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income (Loss) as our "Statements of Operations," and (iv) our Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows as our "Statements of Cash Flows." References to numbered "Notes" refer to Notes to our Consolidated Financial Statements included in Item 8.

The statements in this discussion regarding our expectations of our future performance, liquidity and capital resources, and other non-historical statements are forward-looking statements. These forward-looking statements are subject to numerous risks and uncertainties. Our actual results may differ materially from those contained in or implied by any forward-looking statements. See "Cautionary Statements Regarding Forward-Looking Information."

This Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations ("MD&A") is intended to be a narrative explanation of the financial statements and other statistical data that should be read in conjunction with the accompanying financial statements to enhance an investor's understanding of our financial condition, changes in financial condition and results of operations. Our objectives are: (i) to provide a narrative explanation of our financial statements that will enable investors to see the Company through the eyes of management; (ii) to enhance the overall financial disclosure and provide the context within which financial information should be analyzed; and (iii) to provide information about the quality of, and potential variability of, our earnings and cash flows so that investors can ascertain the likelihood of whether past performance is indicative of future performance.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家地理分佈多元化的遊戲及休閒娛樂公司，於1973年由Carano家族成立，並在內華達州雷諾市開設Eldorado Hotel Casino。自2005年起，本公司透過一系列收購活動成長，包括2014年收購MTR Gaming Group, Inc.、2017年收購Isle of Capri Casinos, Inc.、2018年收購Tropicana Entertainment, Inc.、2020年收購Caesars Entertainment Corporation，以及2021年收購William Hill PLC。本公司在NASDAQ股票市場的股票代碼為"CZR."
本公司主要營收來自遊戲運營，包括賭場設施、零售及線上運動賭博與線上遊戲。此外，本公司亦利用酒店、餐廳、酒吧、娛樂、賽馬、零售商店及其他服務吸引顧客至本公司設施。

截至2025年12月31日，本公司擁有、租賃或管理總計18個州的52處國內設施。本公司亦在北美洲34個司法管轄區進行體育賭博運營，其中27個提供線上運動賭博，並在北美洲5個司法管轄區運營iGaming。本公司目前運營Caesars Sportsbook應用程式、Caesars Racebook應用程式、Caesars Palace Online Casino應用程式及Horseshoe Online Casino應用程式。本公司預期將持續在Caesars Digital分部擴張業務，因新司法管轄區合法化零售及線上運動賭博與iGaming。此外，本公司在北美洲擁有其他經授權使用Caesars Entertainment, Inc.品牌與標誌的設施，以及其他非遊戲設施。本公司從第三方租賃部分實體資產，包括GLP Capital, L.P.，為Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc.（"GLPI"）的運營合夥企業，以及VICI Properties L.P.，一家德克薩斯州有限合夥企業（"VICI"）。請參閱第2項"設施"，以取得更多關於本公司設施的資訊。
本公司整體業務由相互補充的業務組成，這些業務相互強化、交叉推廣並彼此支援：賭場，包括賭場設施、零售及線上運動賭博與iGaming、餐飲、酒店、賭場管理或品牌、娛樂、零售及其他業務運營。
本公司賭場運營的收入來自約51,400臺賠率機、2,700臺桌遊，包括德州撲克、零售及線上運動賭博、iGaming及其他遊戲如開獎機，所有這些佔本公司2025年總淨營收約58%。賠率機產生本公司賭場收入的絕大多數。
零售及線上運動賭博與iGaming

本公司在北美洲34個司法管轄區進行體育賭博運營，其中27個提供線上運動賭博，並在北美洲5個司法管轄區運營iGaming，截至2025年12月31日。本公司提供數百種線上賭場遊戲，包括賠率機、桌遊、現場經紀人及視訊撲克，並預期隨著iGaming在更多州合法化而增加產品選擇。本公司持續利用World Series of Poker（"WSOP"）品牌於美國，透過與WSOP品牌在2024年10月29日出售時同時簽訂的授權協議。

本公司Caesars Sportsbook應用程式運行於本公司擁有並整合的技術平台，我們稱之為Liberty（"Liberty"）。此應用程式提供廣泛的賽前及賽中賠率市場、廣泛的賠率與靈活的賠率限制、玩家專屬賠率及同場賠率組合。除了Caesars Sportsbook應用程式，本公司與NYRABets LLC合作，NYRABets LLC為紐約賽馬協會（New York Racing Association, Inc.）的官方線上賭博平台，並在22個州運營Caesars Racebook應用程式。Caesars Racebook應用程式提供對全球超過300個賽馬場的讓分賠率投注，以及賽事直播串流。此外，本公司於2023年推出Caesars Palace Online Casino應用程式，於2024年推出Horseshoe Online Casino應用程式。於2025年，本公司將Caesars Racebook賠率界面加入Caesars Sportsbook應用程式，並推出一個通用數位錢包，以單一錢包存取資金及Caesars Rewards。這些功能目前在幾個州可用，並計畫未來擴展至更多司法管轄區。在本公司Caesars Sportsbook、Caesars Racebook及iGaming行動應用程式下進行的投注，可累積Caesars Rewards忠誠度計畫的積分或可兌換免費投注信用的點數。未滿21歲的客戶不得在本公司Caesars Sportsbook、Caesars Racebook及iGaming行動應用程式下進行投注。Caesars Digital分部的業務持續成長，因司法管轄區持續合法化零售及線上運動賭博、iGaming及線上賽馬投注。
本公司餐飲與酒類業務之收入來自於設置於各賭場內之餐廳、酒吧、夜總會及休息室，於2025年約佔本公司總淨銷售額之15%。許多本公司之設施包含多種餐飲選擇，從高檔餐飲體驗至價格中等之餐廳不等，其中部分提供外帶或客房送餐服務。
酒店業務之收入來自於本公司各設施約45,600間客房與套房之住宿服務，於2025年約佔本公司總淨銷售額之17%。本公司各設施提供不同價格與服務層級，使本公司能接待多種類型之賭場旅客，其造訪本公司設施主要是為參與賭博及其他賭場娛樂活動，以及非賭場旅客，其造訪本公司設施為其他用途，如休閒旅遊或會議展覽。
本公司從北美洲其他酒店與賭場之管理費收入中獲取收入。管理中之設施為以Caesars為品牌的設施，本公司於管理契約下提供部分人力與管理服務。此外，本公司授權使用Caesars Entertainment, Inc.之部分品牌與商標，並從相關安排中收取費用作為收入。
娛樂及其他非賭博業務

本公司於各設施內提供多樣化之零售與娛樂服務。本公司於美國各處經營多種娛樂場地，包括位於Caesars Palace Las Vegas之Colosseum以及位於Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino之PH Live。這些獲獎肯定之娛樂場地舉辦或已宣佈將舉辦知名藝人如Rod Stewart、Jerry Seinfeld、Kelly Clarkson、Def Leppard、Dolly Parton、Jennifer Lopez及Blake Shelton等之演出。

於2024年12月12日，本公司出售LINQ Promenade，該為位於The LINQ Hotel & Casino與Flamingo Las Vegas之間之開放式餐飲、娛樂與零售開發設施。本公司持續營運High Roller，為一550英尺之觀景摩天輪，以及Fly LINQ，為位於The LINQ Hotel & Casino與Flaming, Las Vegas之間之拉斯維加斯大道上首座且唯一之繩索滑行設施。

paragraphs: 以下討論應配合審計後之合併財務報表及其附註，以及其他財務資訊一併閱讀，並以之為準。
Caesars Entertainment, Inc.，一家內華達州公司，及其子公司，可能被稱為 "本公司"、"CEI"、"Caesars"、"我們"、"我們的"、"我們" 或 "登記人"。
我們亦指 (i) 我們的合併財務報表為 "財務報表"，(ii) 我們的合併資產負債表為 "資產負債表"，(iii) 我們的合併營業表及合併綜合損益表為 "營業表"，(iv) 我們的合併現金流量表為 "現金流量表"。提及數字 "附註" 指的是我們的合併財務報表附註，包含於項目 8 中。
本討論中關於我們對未來表現、流動性及資本資源的預期，以及其他非歷史性陳述，為前瞻性陳述。這些前瞻性陳述受到許多風險與不確定性影響。我們的實際結果可能與任何前瞻性陳述中所包含或暗示的結果有重大差異。請參閱 "關於前瞻性資訊的警示聲明"。

本管理層討論與分析財務狀況及營運結果 ("MD&A") 的目的，是提供財務報表及其他統計資料的敘述性說明，應與附隨的財務報表一併閱讀，以增進投資人對我們財務狀況、財務狀況變動及營運結果的瞭解。我們的目標為：(i) 提供財務報表的敘述性說明，使投資人能從管理層的視角瞭解本公司；(ii) 增強整體財務揭露，並提供財務資訊應被分析的背景；(iii) 提供有關我們獲利與現金流量的品質及潛在變動性資訊，使投資人能判斷過去表現是否代表未來表現。

我們是一家地理上分散的賭博與旅館業公司，於1973年由Carano家族成立，並於內華達州Reno開設Eldorado Hotel Casino。自2005年起，我們透過一系列收購成長，包括2014年收購MTR Gaming Group, Inc.、2017年收購Isle of Capri Casinos, Inc.、2018年收購Tropicana Entertainment, Inc.、2020年收購Caesars Entertainment Corporation，以及2021年收購William Hill PLC。我們在NASDAQ股票市場的股票代碼為 "CZR"。

我們擁有、租賃或管理總計52間國內外的旅館與賭場，分佈於18個州，截至2025年12月31日，約有51,400臺賭機、視訊彩券機與電子桌遊戲，約有2,700桌賭遊戲，以及約45,600間旅館客房。此外，我們在北美地區還有其他被授權使用Caesars Entertainment, Inc.品牌與標誌的旅館與賭場。我們的主要收入來自賭博業務，包括賭場、零售與線上運動賭博及線上賭博。此外，我們利用旅館、餐廳、酒吧、娛樂、賽馬、零售商店及其他服務來吸引顧客至我們的旅館與賭場。

截至2025年12月31日，我們擁有22間賭場，並租賃24間賭場於美國。我們從VICI Properties L.P.，一家內華達州有限合夥企業 ("VICI") 租賃18間賭場，根據區域租賃、拉斯維加斯租賃及Joliet租賃 ("VICI租賃")。此外，我們從GLP Capital, L.P.，Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc. ("GLPI") 的營運合夥企業租賃6間賭場，根據主租賃 (經修正後，"GLPI主租賃") 及Lumière租賃 (與GLPI主租賃合稱 "GLPI租賃")。請參閱下文的 "GLPI租賃" 及 "VICI租賃" 描述。
本公司經營及進行零售及線上運動賭博業務，遍及北美洲34個司法管轄區，其中27個提供線上運動賭博。此外，本公司亦在北美洲5個司法管轄區經營iGaming業務。下圖說明Caesars Digital截至2025年12月31日的業務據點：

本公司與NYRABets LLC合作，NYRABets LLC為紐約賽馬協會（New York Racing Association, Inc.）的官方線上賭博平台，並於截至2025年12月31日的22個州運作Caesars Racebook應用程式。Caesars Racebook應用程式提供用戶透過全球超過300個賽馬場進行 pari-mutuel 賭博的服務，並提供賽事直播。所下注的賭注可轉換為本公司Caesars Rewards忠誠度計畫的積分，或可兌換免費賭博信用額。
本公司亦正在進行擴張Caesars Digital業務據點至其他州的計畫，於近期內司法管轄區合法化或提供必要批准後，將透過Caesars Sportsbook、Caesars Racebook及iGaming行動應用程式進行。本公司不允許未滿21歲的客戶使用Caesars Sportsbook、Caesars Racebook及iGaming行動應用程式進行賭博。
本公司會定期處置資產以籌集資金，或在先前案例中，為符合反壟斷、賭博及其他監管機構所設的條件、條款、義務或限制。以下為截至2025年12月31日已完成的資產處置總結：

headings: 與經營本公司業務相關的風險
我們面臨相當程度的競爭，且預期此競爭將持續存在。
本公司業務對消費者自發性支出減少相當敏感，此種減少可能因經濟衰退或其他超出我們控制範圍的因素所致。
我們數位業務的成長將需要投資於線上產品、技術與戰略性行銷計畫，此種投資可能成本高昂，並對我們線上業務的經濟效益產生負面影響。
我們面臨詐欺、竊盜及欺詐的風險。
我們對部分客戶提供信用，我們可能無法從信用客戶處收回遊戲應收款。
疫情及其他公共衛生議題的爆發及其相關影響，已對我們的營運及營運成果產生重大影響，且可能再次產生重大影響。
恐怖攻擊、戰爭、自然災害、極端天氣及政治、經濟與軍事情勢等行為，可能影響我們的營運能力，或對我們的財務成果產生負面影響。
氣候變遷規範及溫室氣體效應可能對我們的營運產生不利影響。
我們的業務可能因季節性變動及其他因素而產生波動，進而對我們的營運成果產生不利影響。
我們的業務特別受到能源或水價的影響，這些價格的上漲可能對我們的營運成果造成損害。
我們的聲譽或品牌聲譽若有所惡化，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果產生不利影響。
與資訊系統及科技相關的風險
我們的資訊系統可能受到入侵，導致機密資訊或客戶個人資訊遭未經授權的存取，這可能對我們的聲譽及業務造成重大損害。
我們的線上業務依賴於互聯網，我們依賴 Amazon Web Services 及其他第三方科技、平台及服務來向用戶提供產品與服務。
與人力資源相關的風險
我們依賴關鍵人員，我們可能面臨吸引並留住合資格員工用於賭場及賽馬場的困難。
罷工及其他勞動問題可能對我們未來的利潤產生負面影響。
我們無法保證能以可接受的條件或任何條件保留我們的表演者及其他娛樂項目。
與我們資本結構相關的風險
儘管我們目前的負債水平，我們及我們的子公司仍可能產生重大額外負債。產生更多負債可能會增加與我們重大負債相關的風險。
我們的浮動利率負債使我們面臨利率波動的風險，這可能會導致我們的債務償還義務顯著增加。
我們賭場的大部分位於租賃土地上。如果我們違約一個或多個租賃合約，相關出租人可能終止影響的租賃合約，我們可能失去相關賭場的佔有權。
法律與監管風險
本公司受廣泛政府規範、稅收政策及許可證制度管制，賭博主管機關對本公司營運有重大控制權，此等情形可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 遊戲產業競爭激烈，我們所經營的市場中，競爭程度普遍很高。我們與多種遊戲運營商競爭，包括陸上賭場、碼頭賭場、河船賭場、賽馬場賭場、位於原住民保留區的賭場，以及其他形式的合法賭博，例如酒吧、餐廳和卡車休息站的視訊遊戲終端機以及網際網路賭博和體育賭博。我們也與其他形式的合法賭博和娛樂形式競爭，例如賓果遊戲、拉動式遊戲機、紙牌館、體育賠率投注、幻想運動網站、遊輪運營、賽馬或賽狗的電話投注、州政府主辦的彩票，以及未來可能與其他場地的賭博競爭。此外，我們還與其他形式的娛樂競爭，以爭取客戶的自由支配開支。在某些情況下，特別是在原住民賭場的情況下，我們的競爭對手可能繳納較低的稅款或無需繳稅。

近年來，許多賭場和網際網路賭博運營商，包括我們在內，已將資金重新投資於現有司法管轄區，以吸引新客戶或爭取市場佔有率，從而增加這些司法管轄區的競爭。特別是，我們和其他網際網路賭博與遊戲運營商已進行廣泛的市場行銷活動，並透過價格與促銷政策進行大量客戶獲取投資。此外，為回應趨勢的變化，拉斯維加斯運營商已專注於擴展其非賭博業務，包括酒店客房升級、新餐飲服務以及新娛樂服務。網際網路賭博與遊戲在新司法管轄區的擴張，以及網際網路賭博與遊戲市場中競爭對手數量的增加，現有賭場娛樂設施的擴張，設施數量的增加，以及許多競爭對手的積極行銷策略，已增加我們所經營市場的競爭，這種強烈的競爭預期將持續。這些競爭壓力已並預期會繼續對我們的財務表現產生不利影響。

我們的實體運營因合法網際網路賭博與投注的擴張，包括我們自己的網際網路賭博與遊戲運營，而在我們所經營的許多司法管轄區面臨日益增加的競爭。此外，我們面臨來自體育賽事投注作為預測市場中受商品期貨交易委員會規範的衍生產品的新競爭。這種新競爭聲稱可全國範圍內使用，目前正由越來越多的提供者提供。雖然我們認為我們透過網際網路賭博與遊戲運營，已處於與新進市場參與者競爭的優勢位置，但競爭態勢正在變化，我們無法保證我們的運營結果不會因合法網際網路賭博與投注的擴張而受到不利影響。

已經合法化賭場遊戲的州可能進一步擴展賭博，而尚未合法化賭博的州，未來可能也會進行合法化。我們也與在加州及其他司法管轄區的原住民賭博運營商競爭，這些司法管轄區的原住民部落運營大型賭博設施或在原住民土地上進行其他形式的賭博活動，我們預期這些活動將持續擴張。在我們市場附近或在司法管轄區內進一步擴張合法賭場遊戲，或在我們運營的州以及鄰近我們運營的州更改賭博法律，可能會增加競爭，並可能對我們的運營產生不利影響。
增加的競爭可能需要我們在行銷、客戶開發和資本項目上進行大量支出，以維持和提升我們網際網路與實體運營的競爭地位，以增加我們設施與產品服務的吸引力並提高其吸引力。由於我們現金流的很大一部分必須用來支付我們現有債務的義務以及租賃義務，因此無法保證我們將有足夠資金進行這些支出，或我們將能獲得足夠的融資以資金這些支出。如果我們無法進行這些支出，我們的競爭地位可能會受到負面影響。

消費者對休閒活動如賭場、酒店、賽馬場、網際網路投注、iGaming及其他形式的休閒或賭博的的需求，特別敏感於經濟衰退、通貨膨脹以及對自由支配開支的影響。因經濟條件、消費者對經濟的觀感或實際情況、高能源與食品成本、利率上升、旅行成本增加、可支配消費者收入與財富減少、戰爭恐懼及未來恐怖襲擊、或廣泛疾病、疫情或其他公共衛生緊急事件等因素所導致的自由支配開支或消費者偏好的變化，可能對休閒與商務旅行、自由支配開支及其他經濟行為領域產生重大不利影響，這些領域直接影響遊戲與娛樂產業，並可能進一步減少消費者對設施與服務的需求
